libOverrides.bundle.mjs: esbuild has no built-in react-native -> react-native-web resolution; this repo is Expo/RN source, not a DOM component library. Added rnWebAliasPlugin + RN_WEB_EXTENSIONS, plus loader/external entries for RN asset requires (ttf/wav) and node:async_hooks (expo-font server-only path). Output contract (header stamp, export evidence) untouched.
libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: zero .d.ts in this repo (no dist build) means componentSrcMap pins alone made components.length>0 and silently skipped the derive-from-src fallback for every unpinned component. Fixed the fallback to trigger on empty .d.ts-derived names, before folding in componentSrcMap, so pins layer on top instead of suppressing full derivation. Also: a componentSrcMap pin only relabeled enrichment metadata, not the synth-entry barrel, so the unpinned file (GameMap.tsx, with a native-only react-native-maps import) was still export*'d and its top-level side effects still ran. Barrel generation now excludes the name-matched default file whenever a pin points elsewhere.
